#*Enjoy a sail around Boston Harbor and the islands for the day!*

_____________________


## Rates
**Private Sailing Charter:** From $1495.00
*All Ages welcome | Price includes up to 6 people*
___________________________________
## Duration
6 hours 
___________________________________
## About
Come enjoy a sail around the Boston Harbor for the day! Spend your day sailing around and exploring all that the inner and outer harbor have to offer. You are welcome to bring snacks, lunch and any libations you like. You can explore the islands and lighthouses up close, we can throw the anchor and take a dip, island hop, and get the extended tour of the area. It’s your boat for the day and we’ll make sure its unforgettable!
